statement: Handwritten entry, interrupt, context-restore, and low-level hardware assembly implements the SavedContext and ABI contracts exactly.
CPU, MMU, interrupt controller, clocks, and memory obey their architectural specifications and operate without physical tampering.
validation: QEMU acceptance plus future physical qualification

statement: GRUB loads the exact signed multiboot image and firmware supplies admitted tables without mutating the measured image.
DMA reaches only explicitly mapped IOMMU or launch-private shared-memory apertures; a physical device outside those mappings is not covered.
validation: cargo xtask verify-dvm plus hostd preflight policy

statement: The compiler, linker, assembler, boot-image tools, and proof runners execute correctly; RustOS does not currently binary-verify their output.
validation: pinned workspace tools, hooks, signatures, and exact source/artifact hashes

statement: The signed Linux DVM kernel and its built-in drivers satisfy their Linux ABI and hardware contracts after artifact admission.
validation: cargo xtask verify-dvm plus authenticated runtime handshake

statement: Kernel debugcon, DVM serial, and host clocks preserve every mandatory acceptance marker used by the selected product scenario; mandatory SMP records are fixed-buffer, serialized, self-framed, checksummed, and accepted only as complete canonical records, while optional diagnostic events may be bounded or sampled.
QEMU and KVM implement the virtual CPU and devices used by the evidence profile correctly.
validation: two consecutive bounded interactive KVM proofs plus negative storage fault proof

statement: Physical boot, interrupt remapping, storage controllers, input devices, display scanout, reset, and firmware behavior are outside the current QEMU evidence profile.
Current functional, integrity, availability, and latency contracts do not prove confidentiality against cache, timing, power, or speculative-execution side channels.
validation: separate side-channel threat model and hardware evidence required
